# Contributing to Translate It!

Thanks for your interest in contributing to Translate It!

Our full contributing guide lives at **[docs/guides/CONTRIBUTING.md](../docs/guides/CONTRIBUTING.md)**. It covers:

- the contribution workflow — finding existing work, choosing where to propose a change, and submitting pull requests;
- coordination and communication rules, including how Issues, Discussions, and Pull Requests are used;
- local development setup, builds, testing, and validation.

Please read it before starting work.
